# Level G: Threat Response - Encounters

Implement `choose_action()` and `compute_damage()` in `student/player.py`.

## Instructions
1. Open `student/player.py`
2. Implement `choose_action(options)` — engine prints the options; return the 0-based index
3. Implement `compute_damage(base, armour)` — return `max(0, base - armour)`
4. (Optional) Add `calculate_critical_hit(base_damage)` to enable critical hits
5. Run `python3 validate.py`
6. Run `python3 run_game.py` and fight the Sentry Droid in the Airlock!
